effect_description_eng: [Start of Your Main Phase] [When Digivolving] By trashing 1 [Mineral] or [Rock] trait card from any of your Digimon's digivolution cards, reveal the top 3 cards of your deck. Among them, add 1 [Mineral] or [Rock] trait card to the hand, or place 1 such card as this Digimon's bottom digivolution card. Return the rest to the top or bottom of the deck.
inherited_effect_description_eng: When effects trash this card from digivolution cards of a [Mineral] or [Rock] trait Digimon,＜De-Digivolve 1＞ 1 of your opponent's Digimon. (Trash the top card. You can't trash past level 3 cards.)
